--LINKREFRESH DECLARE @LAN VARCHAR(30) = '#LOGIN_LAN#'; DECLARE @LANX3 VARCHAR(30) = ( SELECT #LC.X3ERP#GETLANX3(@LAN) ); DECLARE @FCY VARCHAR(10)='{0}'; DECLARE @MFGNUM VARCHAR(30)='{1}'; DECLARE @ITMREF NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{2}%'; DECLARE @ITMDES NVARCHAR(100)=N'%{3}%';
UPDATE XWS SET XWS.SUBDATIM_0 = Getdate() ,XWS.STAT_0 = 2 ,XWS.BATCHID_0 = '#LINKID_ACTION#' FROM XWSMKM XWS INNER JOIN ITMMASTER ITM ON XWS.ITMREF_0 = ITM.ITMREF_0 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN1 L1 ON L1.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L1.LANX3 = @LANX3 LEFT JOIN ITMLAN2 L2 ON L2.ITMREF = ITM.ITMREF_0 AND L2.LANX3 = @LANX3 INNER JOIN MFGITM MFI ON MFI.MFGNUM_0 = XWS.MFGNUM_0 AND MFI.MFGLIN_0 = XWS.MFGLIN_0 LEFT JOIN SORDER R ON R.SOHNUM_0 = MFI.VCRNUMORI_0 WHERE XWS.USERID_0 = '#LOGIN_USER#' AND XWS.RPFLG_0 <> 3 AND XWS.STAT_0 = 1 AND XWS.MFGFCY_0 = @FCY AND XWS.MFGNUM_0 LIKE @MFGNUM AND ITM.ITMREF_0 LIKE @ITMREF AND Upper(ISNULL(L1.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES1_0) + ISNULL(L2.ITMDES, ITM.ITMDES2_0)) LIKE Upper(@ITMDES)
